name: Taste of Denmark
notes: All 4 photos were legible menu pages (1 and 3 are the same laminated/printed menu shot twice, 2 is a fall-special insert, 4 is a second page). Prices differ slightly between photos 1 and 3 for a few items (rye sandwiches $9 vs $8, meatball sliders $14 vs $13, breakfast sausages $13 vs $11); used photo 1's (laminated menu) prices as canonical.

dishes.name: Daily Selection of Open Faced Rye Sandwiches
dishes.description: Artfully stacked buttered rye sandwich only $9 or 3 for $22

dishes.name: Grill Bar Burger
dishes.description: Rib roast burger with cracklings, pickled red cabbage and remoulade.

dishes.name: Beef Sandwich
dishes.description: Ground beef sandwich completed with the traditional Danish brown gravy.

dishes.name: Meat Ball Sliders
dishes.description: 2 toasted sliders with our Danish meatballs, thinly chopped fresh red cabbage, homemade cucumber salad, salad leaf and mayo (Gluten free)

dishes.name: 2 Sausages with Bun
dishes.description: Classic Danish red or brown sausages - your choice. Served with 3 condiments mustard, ketchup and remoulade.

dishes.name: 2 Breakfast Sausages with Eggs and Bacon
dishes.description: 2 pork sausages with 2 eggs and 2 bacon

dishes.name: Traditional Danish Hot Dog with Panfried Sausage
dishes.description: On toasted bun panfried sausage topped with raw and crispy onions 3 condiments and homemade pickled cucumbers

dishes.name: All Famous Danish Hot Dog with Boiled Red Sausage
dishes.description: On toasted bun boiled red sausage topped with raw and crispy onions 3 condiments and homemade pickled cucumbers

dishes.name: Meatballs with Potato Salad
dishes.description: Served with a fresh delightful potato salad and classic Danish brown gravy.

dishes.name: Old School Danish Omelet
dishes.description: Served with ryebread, accompanied by thin slices of bacon, cucumbers, tomato and green onions.

dishes.name: Tartlet
dishes.description: Organic chicken in creamy roux sauce, plated in crispy flacky puff pastry bowl with asparagus, sprinkled with a generous touch of finely chopped parsley

dishes.name: Pan Fried Pork Belly
dishes.description: Rustic plated thickly sliced pan fried pork belly served with a rich parsley gravy potatoes and pickled beets

dishes.name: Hot Smoked Salmon
dishes.description: On a bed of spinach leafs, topped with a poached egg, homemade hollandaise and croutons.

dishes.name: Potato Leek Soup
dishes.description: Creamy potato leek soup with a dash of heavy cream and micro greens - served with toasted bun (Vegetarian, add bacon $1)

dishes.name: Sweet Danish Pancakes
dishes.description: 2 butter glazed danish pancakes with caramalized nuts and caramel or chocolate sauce

dishes.name: Aebleskiver
dishes.description: 4 fluffy molded "pancake balls" crusty exterior and soft center dusted with powder sugar and served with jam.

dishes.name: Apple Trifle
dishes.description: Danish classic, delicate layers of apple compote and buttery caramelized bread crumble, crowned with airy whipped cream

dishes.name: Danish Flat Pancakes
dishes.description: Your choice of two toppings and whipped cream; fresh strawberries, Nutella, caramelized nuts, caramel sauce, strawberry jam, powdered sugar, sprinkles, blueberry coulis, apple compote or cookie butter. (can be made glutenfree)
